title: E Co
description: Plan group events without the back-and-forth. Create an event, invite your group by email, and get everyone scheduled — no sign-up required for guests. Each person submits their available time slots and constraints (dietary needs, budget, accessibility), and once everyone responds the best time is automatically confirmed with a calendar invite. Alternate times are available to switch to, and notifications keep everyone informed at every step. Built with React, TypeScript, and Supabase with passwordless magic-link authentication.
